header.description: Lair cache (FAM-11, stock): LoadLairInfo, GetLairInfo, SetLairInfo and GetLairInfoIndex with the real GetDamageOutput, CalcCombatRounds and GetPreCalculatedMonsterDamage, for loaded characters and parties.
notes: Characters are the pipeline scenario's ladder-c1-l50 (warrior: weapon attack; rogue: the same with backstab), ladder-c12-l50 (mage, spell attack) and ladder-c15-l50 (mystic, martial arts): RefreshAll runs in the oracle, then SetCurrentAttackTypeConfig, LoadLairInfo and the GetLairInfo calls; each GetLairInfo result is an output r<i> (LairInfoType, lower-cased member names). 'config' is sGlobalAttackConfig afterwards.

The Lairs and Monsters tables are the stock database. The Rust test builds its World from data.table: the chosen lairs and the monsters in their mob lists only; the oracle loads all 421 lairs, which cannot change a chosen one.

nMonsterDamageVsChar and nMonsterDamageVsParty are family-wide arrays of invented, fixed values for the monsters of the chosen lairs; -1 means 'not calculated', so GetMonsterAvgDmgFromDB answers (the stored AvgDmg).
CalculateMonsterPartyDamage (frmMain) calls CalculateMonsterDamageVsCharALL, which the oracle cannot run (progress bar form); the Rust test checks it against the per-monster function.
Call lists repeat some pairs, so the cached-damage path and the second call with another max regen are covered.
